item.text: Structure is clear: daily codes (P/A/L/H) plus summary columns. Now computing absent-day counts per staff.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('staff_attendance_aug.xlsx', sheet_name='Attendance Aug 2025')
day_cols = [str(d) for d in range(1, 32)]
# count A from daily cells, cross-check with summary column
df['A_daily'] = df[day_cols].apply(lambda r: (r == 'A').sum(), axis=1)
df['A_summary'] = pd.to_numeric(df['A'])
mismatch = df[df['A_daily'] "'!= df['"'A_summary']]
print('mismatches between daily count and summary col:', len(mismatch))
if len(mismatch): print(mismatch[['Staff ID','Name','A_daily','A_summary']])
top = df.sort_values('A_daily', ascending=False).head(6)
print(top[['Staff ID','Name','Designation','A_daily']].to_string(index=False))
print()
print('max absent days:', df['A_daily'].max(), '| staff with that count:', (df['A_daily']==df['A_daily'].max()).sum())
\""
